description: This Java source file defines the `KeywordIndex` class responsible for indexing product-related data for keyword search in the OFBiz framework. It gathers product attributes, features, classifications, related content, and variant information to build a keyword index for search optimization.

classes.name: KeywordIndex
classes.description: Utility class for indexing product data for keyword search purposes in OFBiz.

methods.name: forceIndexKeywords
methods.description: Triggers re-indexing of keywords for a given product, forcing an update regardless of existing index status.

methods.name: indexKeywords
methods.description: Main method that performs indexing of product data, gathering attributes, features, related content, and variants to build keyword entries.

methods.name: addWeightedDataResourceString
methods.description: Adds the text content from a data resource, with specified weight, to the list of strings to be indexed.

methods.name: addWeightedKeywordSourceString
methods.description: Adds a specific string field from a generic value to the list of strings for indexing, applying an optional weight.
